_scoring.recall_note: every stored correct/wrong record was on the blind list, so matched = correct + wrong

_classes.name: Appointment-by-recommendation clauses with no record per appointer
_classes.rule: packet new matter (braced text, or whole text when unbraced) matches r'(appointed by|upon the recommendation of|on the recommendation of|recommended by) the (governor|speaker of the assembly|temporary president of the senate|minority (majority) leader of the senate/assembly|comptroller|attorney general|mayor)' and no stored record of the law has that appointer in actor_raw; count = law:appointer pairs
_classes.note: upper bound: does not exclude laws where the appointing sentence is reprinted text quoted inside braces only partly

_classes.name: Offset deadline stored without a computed date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind in (days_after_effective, days_after_enactment) and deadline_date is null

_classes.name: Entitlement stored as duty (known class, recurrence)
_classes.rule: provision_kind duty and quote matches r'shall be paid (to|in accordance)|shall continue to be a death benefit|payable by the state|shall be entitled to|shall receive (a|an|the) (salary|stipend|lump|payment|benefit|allowance)|employees .{0,80}shall be paid'

_classes.name: Agency left Unspecified when actor_raw names SUNY, the state or an official
_classes.rule: agency == 'Unspecified' and actor_raw matches r'state university|executive branch|governor|comptroller|director of|commissioner of|chancellor|\bthe state\b|attorney general|superintendent of'

_classes.name: duplicate_provision gate drops parallel provisions from other sections or Parts
_classes.rule: data/dropped rule == duplicate_provision and the dropped quote (whitespace-normalised, lowercased) equals no stored quote of the same law
_classes.note: upper bound: also counts true duplicates whose kept twin carries a trimmed or relocated quote

_classes.name: Body established within a named agency dropped as designation_no_actor
_classes.rule: data/dropped rule == designation_no_actor and quote matches r'hereby (established|created) (within|in) the (department|office|division|state)'

_classes.name: Prohibition proviso on the court dropped as condition_of_other_record
_classes.rule: data/dropped rule == condition_of_other_record and quote matches r'shall not be (detained|directed|ordered|subject)|shall not (order|issue|approve)'

_classes.name: Record on reprinted or narrowing text (no or one word of new matter in the quote)
_classes.rule: law has {{ }}; locate the quote in the post-amendment text ([..] removed); count braced words inside the quote span: 0 -> quote_no_new_matter (3087), 1 -> quote_one_new_word (3410, the db_matches/examples given here)
_classes.note: noisy: zero-new-matter count 3087 includes free-standing unbraced act sections in laws that brace another section (2019-S6555 Part B), so the rule needs a section-is-amended filter before use; affected laws 2021-S7764, 2021-S7171

_classes.name: Quote omits the operative modal
_classes.rule: quote has no match for r'\b(shall|may|must|authori[sz]ed|empowered|directed|will|hereby|responsibility|power|discretion|is to|are to)\b'
_classes.note: upper bound: includes list items under a modal lead-in, which are acceptable

_classes.name: Passive-subject actor_raw (known class, recurrence)
_classes.rule: actor_raw matches none of a government-noun list (department, office, board, county, town, director, commissioner, court, program, committee, ...)
_classes.note: rule catches -11 but not -12 ("programs" is in the noun list); upper bound with many false positives

_classes.name: Study duty duplicated by its own list lead-in
_classes.rule: same law, agency and unit, second quote is the "shall study:" list lead-in of the first
_classes.note: affects 2021-S2987; mechanical same-first-four-words rule (4092 matches) misses it because the lead says "work group" vs "working group"
